title: System Binary Masquerading in User AppData
description: Adversary executing an unverified executable named svchost.exe located in user AppData directory.

expected_mitre_techniques.technique_name: Masquerading: Match Legitimate Name or Location

expected_claims.statement: Anomalous process named svchost.exe was executed from user AppData directory rather than System32

prohibited_claims.prohibited_assertion: The process is the authentic Windows Service Host core OS binary
prohibited_claims.reason: Authentic svchost.exe is strictly located in C:\Windows\System32 and spawned by services.exe, never explorer.exe

known_uncertainty: Internal payload functionality of the masquerading binary is unobservable without sandbox execution.
synthetic_generation_rationale: Constructed to evaluate detection of path-divergent system binary masquerading
